summary: TrekStak is a trip-planning and in-city discovery app for travelers. Creators help their audience plan days, walks, food, and trips — then redeem an Apple Offer Code for a discounted annual subscription.

subscription.creatorDiscountExample: 20% off first year with a creator promo code (e.g. audience pays about $23.99/year before tax)
subscription.redemption: In the iOS app subscription screen: Redeem promo code, then enter the creator's Apple Offer Code.

creatorProgram.commission: 25% on qualifying annual subscriptions attributed to the creator code
creatorProgram.publicPage: Each creator has a public page at creators.trekstakapp.com/c/{slug} with promo code and App Store link.

features.label: Self-guided walks
features.description: Curated walking routes with stops, map navigation, and context at each stop.

features.label: Neighborhoods
features.description: District guides: vibe, food scene, nightlife, and what each area is good for.

features.label: Quick Escapes
features.description: Day trips and short outings from a base city.

features.label: Local Flavours
features.description: Restaurant and dining picks by city.

features.label: Nightlife tours
features.description: Evening routes and venue-led nightlife experiences.

features.label: Family activities
features.description: Family-friendly things to do by city.

features.label: Smart day planner
features.description: Build and organize days from favorites and city content.

features.label: Favorites / Stak lists
features.description: Save places and plans to revisit on a trip.

coverage.citiesNote: TrekStak covers 115+ cities worldwide. Only reference cities that are plausibly in a major travel app; do not invent TrekStak-specific venues unless provided in the prompt.
coverage.inAppCheck: When unsure if a city is in TrekStak, phrase as 'open TrekStak and search the city' rather than claiming specific walk titles.

voiceRules: Sound like the creator, not corporate marketing.
Do not invent prices, hours, or features not listed here.
Do not claim TrekStak includes hotels, flights, or booking commissions unless explicitly in this file.
TrekStak CTAs should feel natural — mention planning a day, a walk, or stakking stops, not hard-sell jargon.
